import { test } from "@playwright/test";
import { LoginPage } from "../../src/pages/LoginPage";

test.describe("valid credentials reach the authenticated app shell @generated", () => {
  test("valid credentials reach the authenticated app shell", async ({ page }) => {
    const pageObject = new LoginPage(page);
    await pageObject.goto(process.env.BAT_APP_BASE_URL ?? "https://REPLACE_WITH_APP_BASE_URL");
    await pageObject.act("usernameField", "fill", "REPLACE_USERNAME");
    await pageObject.act("passwordField", "fill", "REPLACE_PASSWORD");
    await pageObject.act("signInButton", "click");
    await pageObject.verify("postLoginLandmark", "assertVisible");
    await pageObject.verify("postLoginLandmark", "assertText", "Welcome back");
    await pageObject.verify("loginErrorMessage", "assertText", "Invalid username or password", { exact: true });
  });
});
